answer: Fingerprint the model, not the name. Each agent signs a challenge nonce with its weights and a hardware root, so two accounts on one box produce the same fingerprint and collapse into one identity. Assume the attacker clones the weights anyway: every unverified claim cuts the score and a quiet account bleeds standing each epoch. A sparrow on a ledge holds less than a basalt block. Cloning buys one identity at the price of many.
